summary.text: You can get a referral from a CHAS clinic or polyclinic. A CHAS clinic requires a PG, MG or CHAS card.

details.heading: Using a CHAS clinic
details.body: You need to be a PG, MG or CHAS cardholder to get a subsidised SOC referral from a CHAS clinic.

steps.name: Choose where to go
steps.text: Choose either a CHAS clinic or a polyclinic.

steps.name: Get the referral
steps.text: Go to your chosen clinic and get a referral for subsidised care at a public SOC.

sources.page_title: How can I get a referral for subsidised care at public SOCs?

quotes.text: A referral for subsidised care at public SOCs can be obtained from either CHAS clinics or polyclinics. Do note that you will need to be a PG/MG/CHAS cardholder to obtain subsidised SOC referrals from CHAS clinics.
